summary: Updated context workflow rules: on NEW chat start, activate the matching task context and archive all unrelated tasks separately; introduced project-wide onboarding context stored in ai_memory/project_context.md.

context.problem: Active context could carry multiple unrelated tasks into a new chat; the repo lacked a durable project-wide onboarding context for new AI chats.

root_cause.description: Startup rules allowed reusing an active_context containing multiple tasks without forcing it to be narrowed to the new chat intent, and there was no dedicated project-wide context artifact for onboarding.
evidence: docs/context_rules_concept.md startup rules did not require archiving non-matching tasks when the intent matched only one task
No ai_memory/project_context.md existed as a stable onboarding reference

changes: Require pruning on NEW chat start: keep only the task matching the new intent; archive the rest to ai_memory/context_history and update contexts_index.yaml
Add project_context concept and storage location (ai_memory/project_context.md)
Add a dedicated rules doc for project_context lifecycle and a recommended template
Update context_rules pseudocode to load project_context and include hooks for project-wide updates

method: Reviewed updated rule text for consistency across concept + switching + pseudocode
Confirmed new files exist and are referenced by the rules
